cases.description: AWT button: UIA invoke reaches the native peer and has no effect; a bounds click on the same UIA element increments the counter once.
AWT TextField: click its UIA bounds, verify physical End and Backspace, then set a Unicode value through UIA.
Swing synchronous modal: open it with a bounds click (JAB invoke blocks for 8 s there) and close it with a bounds click inside the modal.
WinForms ListBox: a bounds click selects an item; an MSAA weak reference is refused without consent, then clicked with acceptWeakReference.
WinForms TabControl: a bounds click on a TabItem selects the page.
DataGridView (no UIA rows or cells): click the grid, select row and cell with keys, edit with F2, typing and Enter.
Owner-drawn canvas without accessible children: click, double, right and middle click, drag and both wheels in screen, window and client coordinates.
Canvas keyboard: Unicode text with Tab, Enter and a surrogate pair, Ctrl+Shift+K, key down and up, refusals.
Other monitors and negative coordinates: move the fixture to every other monitor and click there. NOT_RUN with one monitor.
Another window takes the foreground: keyboard and pointer input to the target are refused without input; activateWindow is tried once.
A topmost window that takes no focus covers part of the canvas: a click there is refused, a click beside it works.
The target exits and restarts; a window of another process is named with the old PID: refused as PERMISSION_DENIED or WINDOW_NOT_FOUND.
An elevated target (UAC prompt, -IncludeElevated): INTEGRITY_MISMATCH before any input.
cases.reason: needs -IncludeElevated and a person to approve the UAC prompt.

cases.description: Foreign input (injected by this script without the session tag) during typing and right before a request: USER_INPUT_CONFLICT.
A drag and a held Shift are interrupted by foreign input: the button and the key are released; a key held at session end is released.
Latency of pointerMove, pointerClick, clickElement, keyPress and typeText against the canvas, with the recorded state checked at the end.
